name: Cardmada
summary: Command a pirate ship and set sail across the Wonderland-inspired world of Cardmada, a swashbuckling tactical card battler where you’ll assemble a misfit crew and take on rival captains ship-to-ship. Designed from the ground up for natural hand and eye interaction, Cardmada puts you directly in command—build poker-inspired card combinations to unleash spectacular cannon attacks, outmaneuver your foes, and turn the tide of battle.
